_about: Day 7 of a plan shows a story by this line: its most concrete moment, worded plainly, the outcome left open. Well-known figures are named (Ram, Sita, Arjuna, Hanuman); lesser-known ones are introduced by who they are (a student, an old vulture). One per prasang of kind 'story' in wisdom_library.json. Revised 14 Oct 2026; merge into the sanscripts library when it is next rebuilt.
